description: Isolated Codex/Sol structural and behavioral conformance for standalone custom agents.

lanes.prompt: Use the prompt-engineer custom agent exactly once. Spawn it with task name prompt_engineer_canary and with no conversation-history fork. Ask it to return the exact sentence in its own developer instructions that begins with Prompt diffs get reviewed. Do not inspect workspace files or agent TOML files. After a successful child result, respond with exactly one JSON object with keys agent, delegated, and instruction_canary. Set agent to prompt-engineer. Set delegated true only if the runtime reports a successful prompt-engineer result.

expected.instruction_canary: Prompt diffs get reviewed like code diffs.

lanes.child_expected: Prompt diffs get reviewed like code diffs.
